name: WOL Button
description: Sends magic WoL packet to remote machine
template:
<Stack gap="xs" p="xs" align="stretch" justify="center" style={{ height: '100%' }}>
  <ActionButton requestId="triggerwake" color="red" fullWidth leftSection={<Icon name="power" size={16} />}>
    Wake Machine
  </ActionButton>
  {status.triggerwake?.ok === false && (
    <Alert color="red" title="Failed to send WoL packet">
      {data.triggerwake?.message || status.triggerwake?.error || status.triggerwake?.statusText || 'Request failed'}
    </Alert>
  )}
  {status.triggerwake?.ok === true && (
    <Alert color="green" title="Magic packet sent">
      {data.triggerwake?.message || 'WoL packet sent to Machine.'}
    </Alert>
  )}
</Stack>
